title: Knowledge heal: audio is a legal flow mediaType, and the isolated-launch lock signature has an orphan cause
description: Two doc lines contradicting the code, found during MPI-634/635 close-out. add-flow/01 says mediaType is image|video while audio is legal and three audio flows ship; testing-harnesses frames the single-instance lock signature as a live-peer collision when a dead session's orphan prints the same thing.
